policy: Findings accepted WHILE MINAMO STAYS PINNED to @mediapipe/tasks-vision 0.10.35. This is a policy statement approved by the repository owner, not an exemption for the shipped app: the pinned version is still guarded with zero tolerance by `pnpm check:mediapipe` (PR CI and release.yml), and no marker is weakened. It only tells the advisory scheduled canary which known failures of upstream releases are expected, so that a new failure, or a known one disappearing, stands out. Edit it only with the owner's approval, like any privacy-policy change.
